hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *"/Sports Interactive/"*|*"/steamapps/common/Football Manager 26/"*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"FM26 saves and game files are read-only (see CLAUDE.md)."}}';; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
